purpose: host whole-entry sentence-by-sentence precheck of long lore entries before the first EXECUTOR dispatch (window 38 lesson)
method: the host compared the long entries 9e927259f8 and 86736c9041 sentence by sentence (and line by line for LF structure) against the frozen workset; findings already covered by SOURCE-CLAIMS are not repeated; every quoted English and Chinese anchor below was machine-checked against the workset; these are in addition to SOURCE-CLAIMS

items: "theft of personal quantities of Atmos absinthe" 的 Atmos 是本库既定“气之部族”（Atmos Tribe），现译“蒸汽牌苦艾酒”无据，建议“气之部族苦艾酒”。
"Will not be allowed healing for wounds sustained when hat caught fire." 现译“当帽子着火造成伤的时候不准接受治疗”残缺，建议“帽子着火时受的伤不准治疗”。
逐行结构：原文 26 行（首行标题、空行、23 条“-”开头记录、末尾空行），每条的 [i]note…[/i] 与该条同行；修复后 LF 恰为 25，行序与原文一一对应，保留每行开头的“-”。
"you may find that you don't need your spells anymore, once you've seen how effective Nature's power is" 现译“但是我想……你就再也不想使用你过去使用的那些魔法了”删去 may（可能会发现）并改成“不想”，建议“不过一旦见识到自然之力有多么有效，你也许会发现自己再也用不着那些法术了”。
"speak to your instructor about following the path of the oozemancer" 现译“也可以和我们的导师交谈，我们向你介绍软泥使的力量”句子残缺且把 path 译成“力量”，建议“可以找你的导师谈谈，走上软泥使之路”。
"unchecked use of arcane magic" 的 unchecked＝不加节制，现译“不恰当的”偏离，建议“不加节制地滥用奥术魔法”。
